senses.gloss:
भोगः [भुज्-घञ्]
—1 Eating, consuming.
—2 Enjoyment, fruition.
—3 Possession.
—4 Utility, advantage.
—5 Ruling, governing, government.
—6 Use, application (as of a deposit).
—7 Suffering, enduring, experiencing.
—8 Feeling, perception.
—9 Enjoyment of women, sexual enjoyment, carnal pleasure.
—10 An enjoyment, an object of enjoyment or pleasure; भोगे रोगभयम्
 Bh. 3. 35; भोगा मेघवितानमध्यविलसत्सौदामिनीचञ्चलाः Bh. 3. 54;
 भोगो विभवभेदश्च निष्कृतिर्मुक्तिरेव च Brav. P.; Bg. 1. 32.
—11 A repast, feast, banquet.
—12 Food.
—13 Food offered to an idol.
—14 Profit, gain.
—15 Income, revenue.
—16 Wealth; भोगान् भोगानिवाहेयानध्यास्यापन्न दुर्लभा Ki. 11. 23.
—17 The wages of prostitutes.
—18 A curve, coil, winding.
—19 The (expanded) hood of a snake; श्वसदसितभुजङ्गभोगाङ्गदग्रन्थि
 &c. Māl. 5. 23; R. 10. 7, 11. 59.
—20 A snake.
—21 The body.
—22 An army in column.
—23 The passing (of an asterism).
—24 The part of the ecliptic occupied by each of the 27 Nakṣatras.
.━{@Comp.@}: भोगार्ह, भोगार्ह्यम्, भोगाधिः, भोगावली, भोगावासः, भोगकर,^1 भोगगुच्छम्, भोगगृहम्, भोगतृष्णा, भोगदेहः, भोगधरः, भोगनाथः, भोगपतिः, भोगपत्रम्, भोगपालः, भोगपिशाचिका, भोगभुज्, भोगभूमिः, भोगभृतकः, भोगलाभः, भोगवस्तु, भोगसद्मन्, भोगस्थानम्
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/5f7cee5.
भोगः + -अर्ह a. fit to be enjoyed.
भोगः + -अर्ह + ({@-र्हम्@}) property, wealth.
भोगः + -अर्ह्यम् corn, grain.
भोगः + -आधिः a pledge which may be used until redeemed.

भोगः + -आवली the panegyric of a professional encomiast; नग्नः स्तुतिव्रतस्तस्य
 ग्रन्थो भोगावली भवेत्; Abh. Cin. 795; भोगावलीः कलगिरोऽवसरेषु पेठुः Śi. 5. 67.
भोगः + -आवासः the apartments of women, harem.

भोगः + -कर^1 a. affording enjoyment or pleasure.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/5f7cee5.
भोगः + -गुच्छम् wages paid to prostitutes.
भोगः + -गृहम् the womenʼs apartments, harem, zenana.

भोगः + -तृष्णा desire of worldly enjoyments; तदुपस्थितमग्रहीदजः
 पितुराज्ञेति न भोगतृष्णया R. 8. 2; selfish enjoyment; Māl. 2.

भोगः + -देहः ‘the body of suffering’, the subtle body which a dead person
 is supposed to carry with him, and with which he experiences happiness
 or misery according to his good or bad actions.
भोगः + -धरः a serpent.
भोगः + -नाथः a nourisher, supporter.
भोगः + -पतिः the governor or ruler of a district or province.
भोगः + -पत्रम् an Inām deed; Śukra. 2. 295.
भोगः + -पालः a groom.
भोगः + -पिशाचिका hunger.
भोगः + -भुज् a. enjoying pleasures. ━m. a wealthy man.

भोगः + -भूमिः f. ‘the land of enjoyment’, heaven, paradise (where
 persons are said to enjoy the fruit of their actions).

भोगः + -भृतकः a
[]
 servant who works only for livelihood.

भोगः + -लाभः
—1 acquisition of enjoyment or profit.
—2 well-being, welfare.
भोगः + -वस्तु n. an object of enjoyment.
भोगः + -सद्मन् n. = भोगावास q. v.

भोगः + -स्थानम्
—1 the body, as the seat of enjoyment.
—2 womenʼs apartments.

भोगवत् a.
—1 Giving pleasure or delight, delightful.
—2 Happy, prosperous.
—3 Having curves, ringed, coiled. ━m.
—1 A snake.
—2 A mountain.
—3 Dancing, acting, and singing together.

भोगवत् + ({@-ती@}) ━f.
—1 An epithet of the Ganges of Pātāla or the lower world (पातालगङ्गा);
 भोगवती च पाताले स्वर्गे मन्दाकिनी तथा Purāṇam; A. Rām. 6. 9. 8.
—2 A female snake-demon; Mb. 1. 171. 38.
—3 N. of the city of the snake-demons in the lower world; आत्मतुल्यबलैर्गुप्तां
 नागैर्भोगवतीमिव Bhāg. 1. 11. 11.
—4 The night of the second day of a lunar month.
भोगिकः [भोग-ठन्] A groom, horse-keeper.

भोगिन् a. [भोग-इनि]
—1 Eating.
—2 Enjoying.
—3 Suffering, experiencing, enduring.
—4 Using, possessing (at the end of comp. in these four senses.)
—5 Having curves, having large body; अभवन् पन्नगास्त्रस्ता भोगिनस्तत्रवासिनः
 Rām. 6. 50. 35 (com.).
—6 Having hoods.
—7 Devoted to enjoyment, indulging in sensual pleasures; भोगिनः कञ्चुकाविष्टाः
 कुटिलाः क्रूरचेष्टिताः । सुदुष्टा मन्त्रसाध्याश्च राजानः पन्नगा इव ॥
 Pt. 1. 65 (where it has sense 6 also).
—8 Rich, opulent. ━m.
—1 A snake; गजाजिनालम्बि पिनद्धभोगि वा Ku. 5. 78; R. 2. 32, 4. 48, 10. 7, 11. 59.
—2 A king.
—3 A voluptuary.
—4 A barber.
—5 The headman of a village.
—6 The lunar mansion आश्लेषा.

भोगिन् + .{@-नी@}
—1 A woman belonging to the kingʼs harem, but not consecrated with him,
 the concubine of a king.
—2 A kind of heroine.
.━{@Comp.@}: भोगीन्द्रः, भोगीशः, भोगिकान्तः, भोगिभुज्, भोगिराज्, भोगिवल्लभम्
भोगिन् + -इन्द्रः, -ईशः Śeṣa or Vāsuki.
भोगिन् + -इन्द्रः, -ईशः Śeṣa or Vāsuki.
भोगिन् + -कान्तः wind, air.

भोगिन् + -भुज् m.
—1 an ichneumon.
—2 a peacock.
भोगिन् + -राज् m. Śeṣa, the lord of snakes; भुजे भोगिराजो गले कालिमा च.
भोगिन् + -वल्लभम् sandal.

भोग्य a. [भुज् ण्यत् कुत्वम्]
—1 To be enjoyed or turned to oneʼs account; समुपास्यत पुत्रभोग्यया
 स्नुषयेवाविकृतेन्द्रियः श्रिया R. 8. 14; Pt. 1. 117.
—2 To be suffered or endured; Me. 1; स पुनर्द्विविधः प्रोक्तो गोप्यो भोग्यस्तथैव च Nārada.
—3 Profitable.

भोग्य + .{@-ग्या@} A harlot, courtezan.
.━{@Comp.@}: भोग्यवस्तु

भोग्य + .{@-ग्यम्@}
—1 Any object of enjoyment.
—2 Wealth, property, possessions.
—3 Corn, grain.
भोग्य + -वस्तु articles of luxury; अस्त्यत्र भोग्यवस्तु वर्षशतोपभोगेनाप्यक्षय्यम् Dk. 2. 4.
